scope: Cast-exclusive skills with reliable identity but unresolved attack subtype

records.name: Beam Rifle
records.notes: Current Xenoverse 2 quest/character documentation confirms Beam Rifle is used by Raspberry/Navel/Guprei and the current Super Attack index lists it as cast-exclusive, but the accessible current category index does not place it under Strike, Ki Blast, Power Up, or Other. Therefore the Ki Blast classification in this historical batch remains lower-confidence and should be treated as an audit item rather than a confirmed subtype.
